<!doctype html><html lang="en"><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>For Sweety 💗</title><style>
:root{--pink:#f9b8cf;--deep:#c94f7d;--ink:#74475b;--cream:#fff8fb}*{box-sizing:border-box}body{margin:0;min-height:100vh;background:radial-gradient(circle at 15% 15%,#fff 0 5%,transparent 25%),linear-gradient(135deg,#ffe5ef,#fff5f8 52%,#fbd4e3);font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;color:var(--ink);display:grid;place-items:center;padding:22px;overflow-x:hidden}.float{position:fixed;opacity:.55;animation:drift 7s ease-in-out infinite;pointer-events:none}.f1{top:8%;left:8%;font-size:30px}.f2{top:15%;right:9%;font-size:24px;animation-delay:1s}.f3{bottom:9%;left:10%;font-size:25px;animation-delay:2s}@keyframes drift{50%{transform:translateY(-18px) rotate(9deg)}}.card{width:min(680px,100%);min-height:510px;background:#ffffffd9;border:1px solid #fff;box-shadow:0 20px 70px #b95e7c26;border-radius:30px;padding:clamp(25px,6vw,54px);text-align:center;position:relative;backdrop-filter:blur(8px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.tiny{font:600 12px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:3px;text-transform:uppercase;color:#c27693;margin-bottom:15px}.title{font-size:clamp(32px,6vw,52px);line-height:1.1;color:#b94e79;margin:4px 0 18px}.copy{font-size:clamp(18px,3vw,22px);line-height:1.65;max-width:530px;margin:0 auto 22px}.mascots{font-size:55px;letter-spacing:8px;margin:0 0 14px}.btns{display:flex;gap:12px;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:12px}.btn{border:0;border-radius:999px;padding:14px 25px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#e77fa5,#c9507e);color:white;font:700 15px Arial,sans-serif;box-shadow:0 8px 20px #d36b9338;cursor:pointer;transition:.2s}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:saturate(1.1)}.btn.alt{background:#fff;color:#bd5b82;border:1px solid #f0b5cb}.dots{display:flex;gap:7px;margin:0 0 22px}.dot{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:#efcada}.dot.on{background:#c95783;width:22px;border-radius:9px}.memory-video{display:block;width:min(100%,420px);max-height:65vh;margin:18px auto;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 12px 32px #9e527333;background:#160b12}.photo{width:100%;border-radius:18px;box-shadow:0 12px 30px #9d466326;margin:8px 0 16px}.foot{font:12px Arial,sans-serif;color:#c18aa0;margin-top:20px}.hidden{display:none}.fade{animation:fade .45s ease}@keyframes fade{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}@media(max-width:480px){.card{min-height:570px;padding:26px 20px}.mascots{font-size:46px}}
</style></head><body><span class="float f1">♡</span><span class="float f2">💗</span><span class="float f3">✿</span><main class="card"><div class="dots" id="dots"></div><div id="screen" class="fade"></div><div class="foot">made with love, just for you ♡</div></main><script>
const collage='data:image/png;base64,
